summary: Explains until with retries (default 3) and delay (default 5) to retry a task until a condition is met; the registered result has attempts, -vv shows each retry, and since 2.16 omitting until retries until success. until can combine with loops, and timeout applies per attempt.
questions: How do I retry a task until its output contains a string?
What are the default retries and delay for until?
How do I retry a task until it succeeds?
Can I use until with a loop?
How many attempts did my until task take?

answer_card.title: Retrying a task with until
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.shell: /usr/bin/foo
  register: result
  until: result.stdout.find("all systems go") != -1
  retries: 5
  delay: 10
```

Defaults: `retries: 3`, `delay: 5`. The result includes `attempts`; run with `-vv` to see each retry. Since 2.16, without `until` the task retries until it succeeds (up to `retries`).

With a loop, `until` applies per item:

```yaml
- uri:
    url: "https://{{ item }}.ansible.com"
  register: uri_output
  with_items: [galaxy, docs]
  retries: 2
  delay: 1
  until: "uri_output.status == 200"
```

`timeout` applies to each attempt.
